inputRootSignature: theorem local_polynomial_reproduction (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (ell : ℕ) (X : Fin n → ℝ) (K : ℝ → ℝ) (hK_nonneg : ∀ u, 0 ≤ K u) (x h : ℝ) (hh : 0 < h) : let U : ℝ → Fin (ell + 1) → ℝ := fun u k ↦ u ^ k.1 / (Nat.factorial k.1 : ℝ) let B : Matrix (Fin (ell + 1)) (Fin (ell + 1)) ℝ := fun a b ↦ ((n : ℝ) * h)⁻¹ * ∑ i, U ((X i - x) / h) a * U ((X i - x) / h) b * K ((X i - x) / h) IsUnit B.det → let W : Fin n → ℝ := fun i ↦ ((n : ℝ) * h)⁻¹ * (∑ a, U 0 a * ∑ b, B⁻¹ a b * U ((X i - x) / h) b) * K ((X i - x) / h) ∀ Q : Polynomial ℝ, Q.natDegree ≤ ell → ∑ i, W i * Q.eval (X i) = Q.eval x
